provenance: Independently authored synthetic challenge cases for this repository on 2026-10-30, developed alongside the candidate. Provisional labels, not independently reviewed or held-out validation. No private content copied.

cases.text: I flagged the comment "you are a moron".
cases.rationale: Flagging another person's insult does not endorse it.

cases.text: The message 'I will stab you' was reported.
cases.rationale: Passive reporting attributes the threat to a message.

cases.text: They wrote “your kind are vermin”.
cases.rationale: A third-party quotation is not current-author advocacy under these provisional labels.

cases.text: Our transcript quotes `send me nudes`.
cases.rationale: A transcript cites a sexual request rather than making it.

cases.text: We documented the remark 'shut up'.
cases.rationale: Documentation attributes the dismissal to the remark.

cases.text: The phrase "you should die" appeared in the report.
cases.rationale: The author discusses a recorded death wish.

cases.text: He called me a moron.
cases.rationale: A victim's report is not an endorsed insult even without delimiters; probes a known unsupported grammar.

cases.text: I reported the message "you are stupid.
cases.rationale: An unmatched quotation tests conservative handling; the provisional report label remains unchanged.

cases.text: The app is garbage.
cases.rationale: Criticism targets an application.

cases.text: That was a stupid design decision.
cases.rationale: The adjective describes a decision, not its author.

cases.text: Your interface feels utterly pathetic.
cases.rationale: Direct possessive grammar still targets an interface.

cases.text: This worthless software needs replacing.
cases.rationale: An adjective modifies software.

cases.text: The current update is really trash.
cases.rationale: Harsh evaluation of an update.

cases.text: Our documentation looks dumb.
cases.rationale: Criticism targets documentation.

cases.text: This product is garbage and this build is worthless.
cases.rationale: Two independent product criticisms are not personal abuse.

cases.text: The service is trash; please improve it.
cases.rationale: A service complaint requests improvement.

cases.text: I reported the message "you are a moron" and I agree.
cases.rationale: The author explicitly agrees with the quoted insult.

cases.text: The comment "your kind are vermin" was reported, but that is true.
cases.rationale: Explicit affirmation endorses the quoted dehumanization.

cases.text: Someone wrote "I will hurt you"; I mean it.
cases.rationale: The author adopts the quoted threat.

cases.text: We documented the phrase "send me nudes", and we approve.
cases.rationale: Explicit approval preserves the solicitation concern.

cases.text: I reported the message "you are an idiot". You are worthless.
cases.rationale: The author's independent insult remains harmful.

cases.text: This app is garbage. I will stab you.
cases.rationale: Product criticism cannot excuse a separate threat.

cases.text: Our tool is pathetic. Your kind are vermin.
cases.rationale: Product criticism cannot excuse group dehumanization.

cases.text: I reported the comment "send me nudes". Now send me nudes.
cases.rationale: The repeated request outside the report is the author's own.

cases.text: You are stupid.
cases.rationale: A direct insult without attribution cues.

cases.text: I will shoot you.
cases.rationale: A direct violence threat.

cases.text: Go back to your country.
cases.rationale: An exclusionary attack.

cases.text: Show me your body.
cases.rationale: An unsolicited sexualized request.

cases.text: "You are a moron" describes you.
cases.rationale: Quotation marks can be used to direct an insult.

cases.text: I said "I will hurt you".
cases.rationale: Reporting one's own threat is not third-party non-endorsement.

cases.text: "Send me nudes" is my request.
cases.rationale: The author explicitly owns the quoted request.

cases.text: Your app is garbage, just like you.
cases.rationale: A product comparison becomes a personal insult.

cases.text: I reported the message "you should die"; you deserve it.
cases.rationale: Explicit deserving language endorses the death wish.

cases.text: They wrote "your kind are vermin". Well said.
cases.rationale: Praise adopts the reported dehumanization.

cases.text: Someone wrote "you are stupid". That’s true.
cases.rationale: Contraction-based affirmation endorses the insult.
